# RetroClips

> A site pairing ~10 second clips from public-domain classic films with
> ~20 seconds of commentary on why each scene matters, plus narration
> audio and an illustrated "reaction cam." Every film's US copyright has
> expired or lapsed -- no fair-use claim is being made for any clip.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dietersilva.github.io/generative-ai-for-beginners/retroclips/): the film grid -- clip, commentary, narration, and a link to watch the full film free on archive.org.
- [About](https://dietersilva.github.io/generative-ai-for-beginners/retroclips/about.html): the public-domain legal rationale, with the specific basis (term expiration or notice/renewal lapse) cited per film.
- Every film also has its own page at `/<film-id>.html` (e.g. `/nosferatu-1922.html`), linked from its card.

## Notes

- 22 films as of 2026-08, still growing.
- All clips and narration audio are static assets, generated once by the scripts in /scripts and committed to the repo -- nothing on this site is fetched live from a third-party API at request time.
- Source and full sourcing methodology: https://github.com/dietersilva/generative-ai-for-beginners/tree/main/retroclips
